messages:
maria: Quick sync — we need to lock MVP cuts by EOD tomorrow. Customer-Alpha asked for SSA integration but that looks like a +3 sprint lift. Proposing an "essentials-first" approach: core chat + embeddings + SSO skeleton (feature-flagged). Defer multi-tenant dashboards and advanced analytics to v1. Thoughts?

devon: +1 to essentials-first. SSA is a big infra + compliance lift. Cutting dashboards saves frontend + infra work and reduces rollout risk.

anya: Can we do SSO skeleton + feature flag so pilot customers get a path without full SSA? That would keep sales motion alive while we buy time.

sam: If dashboards are punted we should remove dashboard links from the nav for MVP and add a CTA for "coming soon". I can ship a microcopy + small nav update.

rafael: From model side, recommend pinning to 13B quantized for MVP to keep latency predictable. If we punt dashboards we should also disable heavy batch evals in the default pipeline.

maria: Good. Also want to be explicit about launch criteria: 99th perc latency < 700ms for chat baseline, telemetry hooks enabled, canary with 3 pilot tenants, rollback playbook documented, and no P0 security/SSO blockers.

devon: I'll draft a risk/dep matrix with effort estimates (S, M, L) and highlight any security/infra blockers. Plan to post in #docs by 17:00 today.

anya: I'll write the feature-flag plan and customer gating rules (who gets SSO early).

sam: Microcopy + nav patch ready by EOD, will include screenshot.

rafael: I'll run perf runs for pinned 13B quantized + one 30B float baseline and post numbers. Expect preliminary numbers by 16:30.

ops-bot: Reminder — Sync scheduled: "MVP cut checkpoint" tomorrow 10:00 in #all-hands.

maria: Action summary: devon = deps & risk matrix; anya = flagging + gating rules; sam = nav + microcopy; rafael = perf/latency estimates. We'll decide final cut list at 10:00 tomorrow. If anyone can't make it, DM me. :thumbsup:

devon: Quick question — is there a minimum set of dashboards metrics we need for launch health? If not, I'd rather ship with basic metrics (requests, errors, latency) and iterate.

maria: Minimal metrics only (requests/errors/latency + token costs). All detailed analytics deferred to v1.

anya: Also flag: sales asked for tenant-level usage export. That can be a v1 add but we should doc expectations to avoid commitments.

rafael: Noted. I'll add perf delta if we switch quantization later; customers may see quality delta — include that in the decision doc.

maria: Thanks team. We'll use the decision doc to set the official milestone reset if needed. Meeting tomorrow will lock MVP vs v1 split.

devon: Posting matrix now: https://redwood.internal/docs/mvp-cut-matrix (will update with ETA/owner).

anya: Quick poll — anyone strongly against deferring dashboards?

sam: no objections — prefer cleaner MVP.

rafael: fine by me.

maria: OK — consensus. See you tomorrow.
